Whether the FY2025 customs-brokerage profit engine (+13% to $4,271,167K on tariff-declaration complexity) survives the February 20, 2026 U.S. Supreme Court IEEPA ruling that invalidated many of the very tariffs creating that complexity. At the February 25, 2026 filing date management would say only: "We are currently assessing the impact this ruling and resulting tariff changes will have on our customs brokerage services, including post-entry activity." — and nothing has been quantified in the six months since.
